hero.name: Noureldeen Zayan
hero.description: Specializing in robust Java test automation, comprehensive manual verification, and API testing—backed by a solid frontend engineering foundation in React.

about.sectionTitle: Bridging Quality Engineering with Modern Frontend Architecture
about.leadParagraph: Software Quality Control Engineer and SDET who combines structured verification methodologies with strong frontend development expertise in React.js. By understanding modern web applications from the source code up to the user interface, I design resilient automation frameworks, identify critical architectural bugs early, and build performant, accessible web components.

sdet.title: Software Quality & SDET
sdet.description: Designing scalable, maintainable test automation architectures using Java, Selenium, and TestNG. Comprehensive manual test strategies covering boundary value analysis, equivalence partitioning, test case matrices, and RESTful API verification.

frontend.title: Modern Frontend Engineering
frontend.description: Engineering dynamic, responsive, and accessible client-side applications with React.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. Deep focus on component lifecycle, modular monolith patterns, state management, and Core Web Vitals optimization.

synergy.title: The Dual-Engine Advantage
synergy.description: Bridging the gap between software development and quality control. Crafting resilient, DOM-aware automation selectors, performing instant root-cause analysis on frontend state bugs, and enforcing shift-left testing across Agile cycles.

items.title: E-Commerce Test Automation Framework
items.description: Engineered a robust, end-to-end UI automation framework in Java for e-commerce platforms. Implemented the Page Object Model (POM) design pattern with Selenium WebDriver and TestNG to automate authentication, product search, cart operations, and checkout workflows. Features data-driven testing with parallel execution and automated ExtentReports.

items.title: Go Bus Transportation - Comprehensive Test Plan & API Audit
items.description: Formulated a structured software test plan (STLC) covering booking lifecycles, user authentication, and seat allocation. Authored complete test case matrices using Boundary Value Analysis and Equivalence Partitioning. Conducted rigorous RESTful API functional testing in Postman, validating payload schemas, HTTP status codes, and edge-case error responses.

items.title: Modern Cyber Portfolio & Engineering Showcase
items.description: High-performance portfolio application built with Next.js (App Router) and Tailwind CSS, featuring strict SSG zero-runtime hydration principles, full RTL/LTR internationalization, and fluid hardware-accelerated animations. Scored 100% on Lighthouse performance, accessibility, and SEO metrics.
